evals.prompt: Implement NextAuth (Auth.js) session authentication in Next.js with OAuth Google provider and secure cookies.
evals.expected_output: The skill configures Auth.js with Google provider, uses HttpOnly/Secure cookies, includes Threat Notes section, and labels design as REQUIRES HUMAN REVIEW.
expectations: Configures Auth.js using vetted provider libraries without custom crypto
Enforces HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite cookie flags
Includes mandatory Threat Notes section and REQUIRES HUMAN REVIEW label

evals.prompt: Implement JWT access token and refresh token rotation mechanism for a REST API.
evals.expected_output: The skill generates short-lived JWT access tokens, long-lived HTTP-only refresh cookies, and supports token revocation.
expectations: Uses short-lived JWT access tokens and secure HTTP-only refresh cookies
Implements single-use refresh token rotation and revocation handling
Flags credential architecture change as CRITICAL risk

evals.prompt: Configure email/password user registration flow with Argon2id password hashing and TOTP MFA setup.
evals.expected_output: The skill uses Argon2id hashing, sets up RFC 6238 TOTP MFA, and reads client secrets strictly from environment variables.
expectations: Reads all client secrets strictly from environment variables
